components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 66px; padding: 8px 15px 8px 19px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eaf0e4; color: var(--ink, #19271e); font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-wordmark svg { flex: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-link { padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 99px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-link:last-child { background: var(--surface, #fffefa); } .ds-link:hover { background: #dce8d5; } .ds-header :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--moss, #275e3f); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-header { min-height: 56px; padding-inline: 12px 8px; } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 17px; } .ds-link { padding-inline: 8px; font-size: .78rem; } } @media (max-width: 360px) { .ds-wordmark { gap: 5px; } .ds-nav { gap: 1px; } }

components.css: .ds-evidence { background: var(--panel, #17291f); color: #f1f6e9; border-radius: 24px; padding: clamp(12px, 2vw, 23px); box-shadow: 0 26px 58px -34px #1a412b80; font: 16px/1.55 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-header, .ds-evidence-labels, .ds-evidence-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-evidence-header { padding: 2px 2px 14px; } .ds-evidence-header strong { display: block; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-eyebrow { display: block; color: #b8cbbb; font-size: .75rem; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-meta, .ds-evidence-labels { font: .69rem/1.45 var(--mono, "JetBrains Mono", monospace); color: #cedccb; } .ds-evidence-labels { padding: 8px 4px 12px; } .ds-evidence-footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--panel-edge, #34503f); padding-top: 10px; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; color: var(--lime, #e0f7ab); font-weight: 600; font-size: .82rem; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lime, #e0f7ab); } .ds-report { min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2c4637; color: #f2f6ec; padding: 6px 13px; font: 650 .8rem/1.55 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-report:hover { background: #3b5848; } .ds-report:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime, #e0f7ab); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-report-arrow { display: inline-block; width: .56em; height: .56em; margin-left: 6px; border-top: 1.5px solid; border-right: 1.5px solid; transform: rotate(45deg); }

components.name: Report tabs
components.description: Sage segmented control with an evergreen active viewport or Changes tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; background: #e6eddf; border-radius: 99px; gap: 3px; } .ds-tab { border: 0; border-radius: 99px; background: transparent; padding: 9px 15px; color: var(--ink-2, #3c5142); font: 600 .875rem/1.55 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #dce8d5; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--panel, #17291f); color: var(--surface, #fffefa); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--moss, #275e3f); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: VisualDetox is an Operate surface for frontend engineers. Newsreader headlines give the workspace an editorial rhythm. Paper and sage ground the controls, and an evergreen pane gives saved captures their own space.
keyCharacteristics: URL-first entry with a real saved comparison alongside it.
Flat rows and visible measurements for reviewing audit results.
Short interaction feedback and visible keyboard focus.
dos: Do keep the URL field and Run audit together as the primary entry point.
Do use real captures with matching dimensions for each comparison.
Do pair every check color with a readable label and keep focus visible on both light and dark surfaces.
